# ilha

> Tiny, isomorphic islands UI library on Effect 4. Function components, order-based `atom()` slots, JSX, SSR via `renderToString`, hydration via `mount(host, C, { hydrate: true })`. Version 0.16.0.

Start with the canonical-usage table: exactly one API per task, plus a never-do list.

## Docs

- [Choose an API](https://ilha.build/guide/getting-started/choose-an-api): task to API table and never-do list
- [Core concepts](https://ilha.build/guide/getting-started/core-concepts): components, atoms, mount, renderToString
- [Full docs for LLMs](https://ilha.build/llms-full.txt): every page as one Markdown file
- [Reference](https://ilha.build/reference/ilha): API reference for ilha

## Diagnostics

- [Error codes](https://ilha.build/errors): ILHA001..ILHA007: cause and fix for each IlhaError

## Tooling

- [Testing](https://ilha.build/guide/recipes/testing): ilha/test render harness
- [Devtools](https://ilha.build/guide/devtools): ilha/debug inspect() and @ilha/devtools
- [Oxlint plugin](https://ilha.build/guide/recipes/oxlint): ilha/oxlint rules

## Recipes

- [Data fetching](https://ilha.build/guide/recipes/data-fetching): Effect Cache + atom(Effect)
- [Server-sent events](https://ilha.build/guide/recipes/server-sent-events): Stream.callback + retry
- [Custom elements](https://ilha.build/guide/recipes/custom-elements): wrap a component as a custom element

## Optional

- [Migrations](https://github.com/ilhajs/ilha/blob/main/packages/ilha/MIGRATIONS.md): removed or changed APIs with replacements

## Package files

- AGENTS.md: agent guide shipped in the npm tarball (public API from source JSDoc)
- MIGRATIONS.md, MIGRATIONS.json: removed or changed APIs with replacements
